name: Cali Blaze RSO Dart | Sour Lemon Diesel
description:
RSO (Rick Simpson Oil) is a full- spectrum whole-plant cannabis oil.

Key Benefits:

•Relieves pain symptoms

•Reduces inflammation

•Alleviates stress & anxiety

•Promotes healthy sleep

•Has been shown to reduce cancer cell growth

• 1-gram of concentrate

• No additives

• Metered syringe delivery

• 60-65%+ THC, broad-spectrum minor cannabinoids, and live resin

Prepare for Usage-

Due to the thickness of RSO at room temperature, it is recommended to warm the product slightly before usage. This can be done by holding the syringe in your hand while closed for a few minutes or by placing the syringe under warm running water with the applicator cap on. Always make sure no water gets into the plunger side.

Sublingual: Depress the plunger on the syringe to release the desired amount and place it under the tongue. Hold Distillate under the tongue for as long as possible to help with absorption, and swallow what remains.

Oral: Fill an empty capsule with Distillate by depressing the syringe to release the desired amount of distillate into the capsule. Close the capsule and swallow with water. Distillate can also be added to food and cooked with for an edible-experience

Topical: Depress the plunger on the syringe to release the desired amount and place it on the skin. Hold the RSO with a bandage to ensure the RSO stays in the desired topical location.
